title: Does my main character's animation feel "off" to you, or am I just overthinking it? Looking for feedback and pixel art workflow tips
author: Faisal_alwaal
selftext:
Hey everyone,

What do you think of my main character's animation in this clip? Something about it feels a bit off to me, but I can't tell if you guys see it too or if I'm just being overly critical of my own work.

Also, what are the best fully AI-driven tools or pipelines for pixel art animation right now? I love the aesthetic of pixel art games, but I don't want to hand-draw or manually keyframe animations myself. If anyone has figured out a pure AI workflow, whether through sprite sheet generators, AI video-to-pixel pipelines, or code-driven procedural animation, I’d love to hear how you're doing it!

comments.author: Upper-Philosophy2376
comments.body: it looks 'off' because it's differnt from the enemy units. I think it's speed related but it might also be missing frames or something like that, could also be the angle of legs etc, I'm not an expert an artist/animtor could diagnose a bit better than me. But I think you feel something because you have two things next to each other that aren't the same, it's the juxtoposition that makes it stand out.

comments.author: erik_33_DK13
comments.body: The end of the flip animations seems a bit fast, like its skipping an animation. The way he holds the sword(while cool) makes the overhead slash look unrealistic. Other than that its cool, unless you specifically asked for critique I wouldn't have noticed any issues.
